title: The Artist's Studio: Care and Share
short_description: Who do you care for, and who takes care of you? This fall, make a postcard for a loved one inspired by the exhibition Mary Cassatt: After Impressionism.
description:
Who do you care for, and who takes care of you? This fall, make a postcard for a loved one inspired by the exhibition Mary Cassatt: After Impressionism.

Visitors of all ages are invited to stop by the museum’s Ryan Learning Center and choose from a variety of activities: create an art project, explore the Multisensory Gallery, and more.

El taller del artista está disponible en español.
